title: Orders
subtitle: Build an order — before sending we check there are enough products for all of it together.

menu.title: Menu
menu.subtitle: How many portions can be cooked from what is in stock.
menu.empty: The menu has no dishes yet

cart.title: Order
cart.emptyHint: Pick dishes from the menu — portions and the total appear here.
cart.notEnough: Not enough for the whole order
cart.refused: Order not taken: products are missing
cart.missingHint: Reduce portions or remove a dish. Nothing was taken from stock.

recent.title: Recent orders
recent.subtitle: Newest first. Tap an order to see what was taken from stock.
recent.emptyHint: The first order appears here as soon as it is sent.

cancel.title: Cancel order {{number}}?
cancel.text: Products go back to the same deliveries if they haven't spoiled yet. Spoiled products can't be returned — they stay written off.
cancel.done: Order cancelled, products are back in stock
cancel.doneLost: Order cancelled. Some products had already spoiled and were not returned.
